description: This file contains unit tests for the EmployeeDependentDao class in the OrangeHRM project, specifically testing CRUD operations and search functionality related to employee dependents.

classes.name: EmployeeDependentDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the EmployeeDependentDao's functionality, including CRUD operations and search functionality related to employee dependents.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test case, setting up the EmployeeDependentDao instance and populating test data.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeDependent
methods.description: Tests saving a new employee dependent and verifies that the data is correctly persisted.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeDependentWithSeqNo
methods.description: Tests saving an employee dependent with a specific sequence number and verifies persistence.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeDependentWithInvalidSeqNo
methods.description: Tests handling of invalid sequence numbers when saving an employee dependent.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeDependents
methods.description: Retrieves dependents for a specific employee and checks the correctness of returned data.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeDependent
methods.description: Retrieves a specific dependent for an employee and checks for correct data or null if not found.

methods.name: testDeleteEmployeeDependents
methods.description: Tests deletion of multiple dependents for an employee and verifies their removal.

methods.name: testSearchEmployeeDependent
methods.description: Tests searching dependents with various filter parameters to ensure correct filtering.

methods.name: testSearchEmployeeDependentWithLimit
methods.description: Tests that the search correctly respects the limit parameter.

methods.name: testGetSearchEmployeeDependentCount
methods.description: Verifies that the count of dependents matching a filter is correct.
